verdict.rationale: CMS IndusLaw is a professional legal-services firm, not a software product, so a built-in AI assistant that a user delegates tasks to is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence shows only practice-area pages, publications and office information. The llms.txt probe returning 404 is not evidence that any in-product assistant exists.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
